title: Evaluation after buffering inputs
statement: Let $C$ be a directed acyclic Boolean circuit with $m$ inputs, let $s$ assign to each of its inputs either one of $n$ input vertices or a fixed Boolean constant, and let $x$ be an assignment of Boolean values to those $n$ inputs. The circuit formed by buffering the inputs according to $s$ evaluates on $x$ to the same value as $C$ evaluates on the assignment obtained by substituting the selected input values and constants.
hypotheses_covered: C is a DAG circuit on m inputs
s maps each of the m inputs to one of n inputs or a Boolean constant
x assigns Boolean values to the n inputs
